# `features/kanban`

Records move between columns by dragging, and the board owns that state.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Records move between columns by dragging, and the board owns that state.
- **Avoid when:** The columns are read-only, or ordering is a table sort.
- **Consider instead:** `features/data-view`, `features/table`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Kanban } from "themelia-ui/features/kanban"
import "themelia-ui/features/kanban.css"
```

## Optional peers

Install these only when importing this family:

```bash
npm install @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/buttons`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Preview recipes

Preview route: Kanban & sync — `/kanban`

### The board

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Kanban
  value={board}
  onValueChange={setBoard}
  getItemValue={(card) => card.id}
  onItemMove={(event) => api.persist(event)}
  itemActions={(card) => card.done ? [reopen] : [archive]}
>
  <KanbanBoard>
    {columns.map((column) => (
      <KanbanColumn key={column.id} value={column.id}>
        <header>{column.title}</header>
        <KanbanColumnContent value={column.id}>
          {board[column.id].map((card) => (
            <KanbanItem key={card.id} value={card.id}>…</KanbanItem>
          ))}
        </KanbanColumnContent>
      </KanbanColumn>
    ))}
  </KanbanBoard>
  <KanbanOverlay />
</Kanban>
```
